claim: Judge Alsup granted preliminary approval on September 25, 2025.
evidence: The settlement agreement was preliminarily approved by Judge Alsup on September 25, 2025.
excerpt: In July, the court certified a class of all rightsholders of books Anthropic acquired from LibGen and PiLiMi, provided the books were registered with the U.S. Copyright Office in a timely manner and have ISBN or ASIN numbers. Judge Alsup certified the class only for piracy, not the act of AI training, and as such the fair use ruling on training applies only with respect to the three named plaintiffs, not the certified class authors and publishers.
